name: migration: a live election's intro is written directly
old:
controlled text[] := CASE kind
      WHEN 'election' THEN ARRAY['name', 'election_date', 'intro']
new:
controlled text[] := CASE kind
      WHEN 'election' THEN ARRAY['name', 'election_date']

name: migration: a change request can't change the intro
old:
updatable text[] := CASE NEW.target_kind
      WHEN 'election' THEN ARRAY['name', 'election_date', 'intro']
new:
updatable text[] := CASE NEW.target_kind
      WHEN 'election' THEN ARRAY['name', 'election_date']

name: migration: a request's intro needs no default locale
equivalent: intro_rules refuses the approved write itself, a live election's intro without the default locale, with the same check_violation

name: migration: an untranslated intro goes public
old: IF NEW.status <> 'draft' AND NEW.intro IS NOT NULL
new: IF false AND NEW.intro IS NOT NULL

name: migration: the rule checks only the drafts' going live, not preview
old: CREATE TRIGGER intro_rules BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF intro, status ON app.elections
new: CREATE TRIGGER intro_rules BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF intro ON app.elections

name: migration: editors can't write the intro
old: GRANT INSERT (intro), UPDATE (intro) ON app.elections TO aiontheballot_admin;
new: GRANT INSERT (intro) ON app.elections TO aiontheballot_admin;

name: migration: the public can't read the intro
old: GRANT SELECT (intro) ON app.elections TO aiontheballot_web, aiontheballot_preview;
new: GRANT SELECT (intro) ON app.elections TO aiontheballot_preview;
